| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Orientation bins** `orientations` | 9 | 2 to 36 | The number of bins between 0 and 180 degrees. Dalal and Triggs use 9. |
| **Cell size** `cellSize` | 8 | 4 to 64 px | The side of the square cells. Dalal and Triggs use 8. |
| **Block size** `blockSize` | 3 | 1 to 8 | The side of the blocks of cells that are normalized together. scikit-image uses 3. |
| **Block normalization** `blockNorm` | L2-Hys | L1, L1 then square root, L2, L2-Hys | How each block is normalized. L2-Hys is L2, then values are clipped at 0.2 and normalized again, as in the paper. |
